</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">yaml</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&#34;role_name,omitempty&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">db</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&#34;role_name&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>Do <strong>not</strong> add this to properties that already inherit it through a <code>$ref</code> to a core schema — the tags are already defined in the referenced definition.</p>
<h3 id="x-go-type-and-x-go-type-import">
	<code>x-go-type</code> and <code>x-go-type-import</code>
</h3>
<p>Tells <code>oapi-codegen</code> to use a specific Go type for a property instead of generating a new struct. Use this for cross-package references and for complex field types like <code>core.Map</code>.</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-yaml" data-lang="yaml"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="nt">metadata</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">object</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">additionalProperties</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">x-go-type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&#34;core.Map&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">x-go-type-skip-optional-pointer</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">x-oapi-codegen-extra-tags</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">db</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&#34;metadata&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>For cross-package references:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-yaml" data-lang="yaml"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="nt">plan</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">$ref</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&#34;../plan/api.yml#/components/schemas/Plan&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">x-go-type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&#34;planv1beta1.Plan&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">x-go-type-import</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">path</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&#34;github.com/meshery/schemas/models/v1beta1/plan&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">name</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">planv1beta1</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="x-internal">
	<code>x-internal</code>
</h3>
<p>Applied to individual API operations (<code>get</code>, <code>post</code>, etc.) to scope them to a specific deployment target. The build pipeline uses this tag to split the merged OpenAPI spec into <code>cloud_openapi.yml</code> (for Meshery Cloud) and <code>meshery_openapi.yml</code> (for Meshery OSS).</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-yaml" data-lang="yaml"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="nt">paths</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">/api/entitlement/plans</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">get</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">x-internal</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">&#34;cloud&#34;</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">   </span><span class="c"># Only included in the cloud bundle</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">operationId</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">getPlans</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>Operations without <code>x-internal</code> are included in <strong>all</strong> bundles.</p>
<h3 id="x-generate-db-helpers">
	<code>x-generate-db-helpers</code>
</h3>
<p><code>x-generate-db-helpers: true</code> is an <strong>optional, schema-level</strong> annotation placed on a named component under <code>components/schemas</code> (not on individual properties). It directs the Go generator to automatically produce <code>Scan()</code> and <code>Value()</code> SQL driver methods for that type in the auto-generated file <code>zz_generated.helpers.go</code>.</p>
<p>These methods implement Go&rsquo;s <code>sql.Scanner</code> and <code>driver.Valuer</code> interfaces, allowing the struct to be transparently serialized as JSON when reading from or writing to a database column.</p>
<h4 id="when-to-use-it">
	When to use it
</h4>
<p>Use <code>x-generate-db-helpers: true</code> when <strong>both</strong> of the following are true:</p>
<ol>
<li>The schema type has a <strong>dedicated OpenAPI schema component</strong> with explicit, named properties.</li>
<li>The type is <strong>persisted as a JSON blob in a single database column</strong>, not spread across a dedicated relational table with one column per field.</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="when-not-to-use-it">
	When NOT to use it
</h4>
<p>Do not use <code>x-generate-db-helpers</code> for:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Amorphous types</strong> with no fixed property set (e.g., a freeform <code>metadata</code> object). Use <code>x-go-type: &quot;core.Map&quot;</code> for those fields instead.</li>
<li><strong>Types that map to a full database table</strong> with individual columns for each property — these are handled by normal DB tag generation on each field.</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="example">
	Example
</h4>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-yaml" data-lang="yaml"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="nt">components</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">schemas</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">Quiz</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">x-generate-db-helpers</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="w">   </span><span class="c"># schema-level annotation</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">object</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">required</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span>- <span class="l">id</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span>- <span class="l">title</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">properties</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="nt">id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">          </span><span class="nt">$ref</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&#34;../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/uuid&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="nt">title</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">          </span><span class="nt">type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">string</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="c"># ... additional properties</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><p>The generator produces the following in <code>zz_generated.helpers.go</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-go" data-lang="go"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">func</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">value</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="nx">Quiz</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">Scan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">src</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="p">{})</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">error</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">src</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">==</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">nil</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="nx">value</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">Quiz</span><span class="p">{}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">nil</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">mapVal</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">core</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Map</span><span class="p">{}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">mapVal</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">Scan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">src</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">nil</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">core</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">MapToStruct</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">mapVal</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">value</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">func</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">value</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">Quiz</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">Value</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">driver</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Value</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">error</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">mapVal</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">core</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">StructToMap</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">value</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">nil</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">nil</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">core</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">Map</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">mapVal</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="nf">Value</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><h4 id="counter-example--metadata">
	Counter-example — <code>metadata</code>
</h4>
<p>A <code>metadata</code> field is also stored as a JSON blob in the database, but it is amorphous — it has no fixed property list. For this reason it uses <code>x-go-type: &quot;core.Map&quot;</code> rather than <code>x-generate-db-helpers</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-yaml" data-lang="yaml"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="nt">metadata</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">object</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">additionalProperties</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">x-go-type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&#34;core.Map&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">x-go-type-skip-optional-pointer</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">x-oapi-codegen-extra-tags</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">db</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&#34;metadata&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><hr>
<h2 id="go-helper-files">
	Go Helper Files
</h2>
<p>While Go structs are auto-generated from schemas, you often need to add <strong>custom methods</strong> to make these structs compatible with databases, implement interfaces, or add utility functions. This is done through manually created <strong>helper files</strong>.</p>
<h3 id="when-to-create-helper-files">
	When to Create Helper Files
</h3>
<p>Create a helper file (<code>*_helper.go</code> or <code>helpers.go</code>) in the generated package when you need:</p>
<table>
  <thead>
      <tr>
          <th>Use Case</th>
          <th>Description</th>
      </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
      <tr>
          <td><strong>SQL Driver Compatibility</strong></td>
          <td>Implement <code>database/sql/driver.Scanner</code> and <code>driver.Valuer</code> interfaces (consider using <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-schemas/#x-generate-db-helpers"><code>x-generate-db-helpers</code></a> instead for types with fixed schemas stored as JSON blobs)</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><strong>Entity Interface</strong></td>
          <td>Implement the <code>entity.Entity</code> interface for database CRUD operations</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><strong>GORM Table Names</strong></td>
          <td>Define custom table names via <code>TableName()</code> method</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><strong>Utility Methods</strong></td>
          <td>Add helper functions for serialization, validation, or business logic</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><strong>Type Conversions</strong></td>
          <td>Add methods to convert between related types</td>
      </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="helper-file-location">
	Helper File Location
</h3>
<pre tabindex="0"><code>models/
├── core/
│   ├── core.go                    # Auto-generated (do NOT edit)
│   ├── helpers.go                 # Manual: utility functions
│   ├── datatype_map.go            # Manual: Map type with SQL driver methods
│   └── datatype_null_time.go      # Manual: NullTime with SQL driver methods
├── v1beta1/
│   ├── model/
│   │   ├── model.go               # Auto-generated (do NOT edit)
│   │   └── model_helper.go        # Manual: Entity interface, TableName, etc.
│   ├── component/
│   │   ├── component.go           # Auto-generated (do NOT edit)
│   │   └── component_helper.go    # Manual: Entity interface, TableName, etc.
│   └── category/
│       ├── category.go            # Auto-generated (do NOT edit)
│       └── category_helper.go     # Manual: Entity interface, TableName, etc.
</code></pre><h3 id="sql-driver-interface-implementation">
	SQL Driver Interface Implementation
</h3>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>Tip</strong>: For types with a fixed schema that are stored as a JSON blob in a single database column, prefer the <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/contributing-schemas/#x-generate-db-helpers"><code>x-generate-db-helpers: true</code></a> annotation on the schema component. This auto-generates the <code>Scan</code> and <code>Value</code> methods for you. Use manual helper files only when the auto-generated methods are insufficient (e.g., custom serialization logic is needed).</p>
</blockquote>
<p>To store complex types (structs, maps, slices) in SQL databases, implement <code>Scan</code> and <code>Value</code> methods:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-go" data-lang="go"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// helpers.go - This is NOT autogenerated</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">package</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">mypackage</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&#34;database/sql/driver&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&#34;encoding/json&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&#34;github.com/meshery/schemas/models/core&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// Scan implements sql.Scanner interface for reading from database</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">func</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="nx">MyComplexType</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">Scan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">value</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">interface</span><span class="p">{})</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">error</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">mapVal</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">core</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Map</span><span class="p">{}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">mapVal</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">Scan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">value</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">nil</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">core</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">MapToStruct</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">mapVal</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// Value implements driver.Valuer interface for writing to database</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">func</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">MyComplexType</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">Value</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">driver</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Value</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">error</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">mapVal</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">core</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">StructToMap</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">nil</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">nil</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">core</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">Map</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">mapVal</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="nf">Value</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="entity-interface-implementation">
	Entity Interface Implementation
</h3>
<p>For structs that need database CRUD operations, implement the <code>entity.Entity</code> interface:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-go" data-lang="go"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// component_helper.go - This is NOT autogenerated</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">package</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">component</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&#34;fmt&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&#34;sync&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&#34;github.com/gofrs/uuid&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&#34;github.com/meshery/meshkit/database&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&#34;github.com/meshery/meshkit/models/meshmodel/entity&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&#34;gorm.io/gorm/clause&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// TableName returns the database table name for GORM</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">func</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">TableName</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#34;component_definition_dbs&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// Type returns the entity type identifier</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">func</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">Type</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">entity</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">EntityType</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">entity</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// GenerateID generates a new UUID for the entity</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">func</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="nx">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">GenerateID</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">uuid</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">UUID</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">error</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">uuid</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">NewV4</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// GetID returns the entity&#39;s ID</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">func</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">GetID</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">uuid</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">UUID</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Id</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// GetEntityDetail returns a human-readable description</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">func</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="nx">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">GetEntityDetail</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">string</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fmt</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">Sprintf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&#34;type: %s, name: %s, model: %s&#34;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> 
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">Type</span><span class="p">(),</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">DisplayName</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Model</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Name</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// Create inserts the entity into the database</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">func</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="nx">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">Create</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">db</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="nx">database</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Handler</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">hostID</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">uuid</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">UUID</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">uuid</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">UUID</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">error</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">_</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">GenerateID</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">db</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">Omit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">clause</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Associations</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="nf">Create</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="nx">Error</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// UpdateStatus updates the entity&#39;s status in the database</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">func</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">c</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="nx">ComponentDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">UpdateStatus</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">db</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="nx">database</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Handler</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">status</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">entity</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">EntityStatus</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">error</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">nil</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="deterministic-id-generation">
	Deterministic ID Generation
</h3>
<p>For entities that need consistent IDs based on their content (to prevent duplicates):</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-go" data-lang="go"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// model_helper.go</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">package</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">model</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&#34;crypto/md5&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&#34;encoding/hex&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&#34;encoding/json&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&#34;github.com/gofrs/uuid&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">func</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="nx">ModelDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">GenerateID</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">uuid</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">UUID</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">error</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// Create identifier from unique fields</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">modelIdentifier</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ModelDefinition</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">Registrant</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Registrant</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">Version</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">       </span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Version</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">SchemaVersion</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">SchemaVersion</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">Name</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Name</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">Model</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">Model</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">            </span><span class="nx">Version</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Model</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Version</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">byt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">json</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">Marshal</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">modelIdentifier</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">nil</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">uuid</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">UUID</span><span class="p">{},</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">hash</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">md5</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">Sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">byt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">uuid</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">FromString</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">hex</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">EncodeToString</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">hash</span><span class="p">[:]))</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="type-alias-and-conversion-helpers">
	Type Alias and Conversion Helpers
</h3>
<p>Add type aliases and conversion methods for convenience:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-go" data-lang="go"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// model_helper.go</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">package</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">model</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// Type alias for cleaner code</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">Styles</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ComponentDefinition_Styles</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// ToReference converts full definition to a lightweight reference</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">func</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ModelDefinition</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">ToReference</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ModelReference</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ModelReference</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">Name</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Name</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">Version</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">     </span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Version</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">DisplayName</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">DisplayName</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">Model</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">       </span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Model</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="nx">Registrant</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">RegistrantReference</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">            </span><span class="nx">Kind</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">m</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Registrant</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Kind</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="core-utility-types">
	Core Utility Types
</h3>
<p>The <code>models/core/</code> package provides reusable types with built-in SQL compatibility:</p>
<table>
  <thead>
      <tr>
          <th>Type</th>
          <th>Purpose</th>
          <th>Use Case</th>
      </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
      <tr>
          <td><code>core.Map</code></td>
          <td><code>map[string]any</code> with SQL support</td>
          <td>Storing JSON objects in database</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>core.NullTime</code></td>
          <td>Nullable time with JSON/YAML support</td>
          <td>Optional timestamp fields (e.g., <code>deleted_at</code>)</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>core.Time</code></td>
          <td>Time wrapper with custom formatting</td>
          <td>Required timestamp fields</td>
      </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>Using Core Types:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-go" data-lang="go"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">package</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">mypackage</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&#34;github.com/meshery/schemas/models/core&#34;</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// For nullable timestamps (e.g., deleted_at)</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">MyStruct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">DeletedAt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">core</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">NullTime</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">`json:&#34;deleted_at&#34; gorm:&#34;column:deleted_at&#34;`</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// For JSON metadata stored as blob</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kd">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">MyStruct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nx">Metadata</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">core</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">Map</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">`json:&#34;metadata&#34; gorm:&#34;type:bytes;serializer:json&#34;`</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="important-notes-for-helper-files">
	Important Notes for Helper Files
</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>File Header Comment</strong>: Always add <code>// This is not autogenerated.</code> at the top</li>
<li><strong>Same Package</strong>: Helper files must be in the same package as the generated code</li>
<li><strong>DO Commit Helper Files</strong>: Unlike generated <code>.go</code> files, helper files ARE committed to the repository</li>
<li><strong>Naming Convention</strong>: Use <code>&lt;package&gt;_helper.go</code> or <code>helpers.go</code></li>
<li><strong>Pointer vs Value Receivers</strong>: Use pointer receivers for methods that modify the struct</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="typescript-integration">
	TypeScript Integration
</h2>
<h3 id="using-generated-types">
	Using Generated Types
</h3>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-typescript" data-lang="typescript"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kr">import</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="nx">v1beta1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nx">v1alpha1</span> <span class="p">}</span> <span class="kr">from</span> <span class="s2">&#34;@meshery/schemas&#34;</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kr">const</span> <span class="nx">component</span>: <span class="kt">v1beta1.Component</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="cm">/* ... */</span> <span class="p">};</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kr">const</span> <span class="nx">model</span>: <span class="kt">v1beta1.Model</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="cm">/* ... */</span> <span class="p">};</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kr">const</span> <span class="nx">design</span>: <span class="kt">v1beta1.Design</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="cm">/* ... */</span> <span class="p">};</span>
</span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="using-schema-exports">
	Using Schema Exports
</h3>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-typescript" data-lang="typescript"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// From main index
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kr">import</span> <span class="p">{</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="nx">ModelDefinitionV1Beta1OpenApiSchema</span><span class="p">,</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="nx">ComponentDefinitionV1Beta1OpenApiSchema</span><span class="p">,</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span> <span class="kr">from</span> <span class="s2">&#34;@meshery/schemas&#34;</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// Direct import
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kr">import</span> <span class="nx">ModelSchema</span> <span class="kr">from</span> <span class="s2">&#34;@meshery/schemas/dist/constructs/v1beta1/model/ModelSchema&#34;</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="maintaining-typescriptindexts">
	Maintaining <code>typescript/index.ts</code>
</h3>
<p>The <code>typescript/index.ts</code> file is <strong>manually maintained</strong> and defines the public API surface. When adding new constructs:</p>
<ol>
<li>Import components from the generated <code>.d.ts</code> file</li>
<li>Import the schema from the generated <code>*Schema.ts</code> file</li>
<li>Add type exports to the appropriate namespace</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-typescript" data-lang="typescript"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// Type imports (no .d.ts extension)
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kr">import</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="nx">components</span> <span class="kr">as</span> <span class="nx">MyPackageComponents</span> <span class="p">}</span> <span class="kr">from</span> <span class="s2">&#34;./generated/v1beta1/mypackage/MyPackage&#34;</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// Schema imports
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kr">import</span> <span class="nx">MyPackageV1Beta1Schema</span> <span class="kr">from</span> <span class="s2">&#34;./generated/v1beta1/mypackage/MyPackageSchema&#34;</span><span class="p">;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// Export in namespace
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kr">export</span> <span class="kr">namespace</span> <span class="nx">v1beta1</span> <span class="p">{</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="kr">export</span> <span class="kr">type</span> <span class="nx">MyPackage</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nx">MyPackageComponents</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">&#34;schemas&#34;</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s2">&#34;MyPackage&#34;</span><span class="p">];</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1">// Export schema
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="kr">export</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="nx">MyPackageV1Beta1Schema</span> <span class="p">};</span>
</span></span></code></pre></div><hr>
<h2 id="common-schema-patterns">
	Common Schema Patterns
</h2>
<h3 id="core-schema-references">
	Core Schema References
</h3>
<p>Always use the non-deprecated references from <code>v1alpha1/core/api.yml</code>:</p>
<table>
  <thead>
      <tr>
          <th>Type</th>
          <th>Reference</th>
      </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
      <tr>
          <td><strong>UUID</strong></td>
          <td><code>../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/uuid</code></td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><strong>Timestamp (created)</strong></td>
          <td><code>../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/created_at</code></td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><strong>Timestamp (updated)</strong></td>
          <td><code>../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/updated_at</code></td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><strong>Version String</strong></td>
          <td><code>../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/versionString</code></td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><strong>Semver String</strong></td>
          <td><code>../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/semverString</code></td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><strong>Input String</strong></td>
          <td><code>../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/inputString</code></td>
      </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="timestamp-fields-pattern">
	Timestamp Fields Pattern
</h3>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-yaml" data-lang="yaml"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="nt">properties</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">createdAt</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">$ref</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/created_at</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">x-order</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="m">14</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">updatedAt</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">$ref</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">../../v1alpha1/core/api.yml#/components/schemas/updated_at</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">x-order</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="m">15</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="preserving-field-order-with-x-order">
	Preserving Field Order with <code>x-order</code>
</h3>
<p>Use the <code>x-order</code> tag to ensure fields appear in a specific order in generated code:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-yaml" data-lang="yaml"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="nt">properties</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">string</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">x-order</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="m">1</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">name</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">string</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">x-order</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="m">2</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">description</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">string</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">x-order</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="m">3</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="referencing-other-constructs">
	Referencing Other Constructs
</h3>
<p>When referencing models or other constructs, add <code>x-go-type</code> and <code>x-go-import-path</code> to avoid generating redundant Go structs:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-yaml" data-lang="yaml"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="nt">model</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">$ref</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">../model/api.yml#/components/schemas/ModelReference</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">x-go-type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">model.ModelReference</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">x-go-type-import</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">path</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">github.com/meshery/schemas/models/v1beta1/model</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">description</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">Reference to the model</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="annotating-api-paths-for-filtering">
	Annotating API Paths for Filtering
</h3>
<p>Use <code>x-internal</code> to control which bundled output includes the path:</p>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-yaml" data-lang="yaml"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="nt">paths</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">  </span><span class="nt">/api/entitlement/plans</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">    </span><span class="nt">get</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">x-internal</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">&#34;cloud&#34;</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="c"># Only included in cloud_openapi.yml</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">      </span><span class="nt">operationId</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l">getPlans</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="w">      </span><span class="c"># ...</span><span class="w">
</span></span></span></code></pre></div><ul>
<li><strong>With <code>x-internal</code></strong>: Included only in the specified clients</li>
<li><strong>Without <code>x-internal</code></strong>: Included in <strong>all</strong> clients</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="template-files">
	Template Files
</h2>
<p>Templates are manually defined files in the <code>templates/</code> subdirectory. They provide example instances with default values.</p>
<h3 id="template-structure">
	Template Structure
</h3>
<pre tabindex="0"><code>constructs/v1beta1/model/templates/
├── model_template.json         # Default JSON template
├── model_template.yaml         # Default YAML template
├── model_minimal_template.json # Minimal variant (optional)
└── model_full_template.yaml    # Full variant (optional)
</code></pre><h3 id="template-content-example">
	Template Content Example
</h3>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-json" data-lang="json"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">{</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="nt">&#34;id&#34;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&#34;00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000&#34;</span><span class="p">,</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="nt">&#34;schemaVersion&#34;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&#34;models.meshery.io/v1beta1&#34;</span><span class="p">,</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="nt">&#34;version&#34;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&#34;1.0.0&#34;</span><span class="p">,</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="nt">&#34;name&#34;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&#34;example-model&#34;</span><span class="p">,</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="nt">&#34;displayName&#34;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&#34;Example Model&#34;</span><span class="p">,</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="nt">&#34;description&#34;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&#34;An example model template&#34;</span><span class="p">,</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="nt">&#34;created_at&#34;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&#34;0001-01-01T00:00:00Z&#34;</span><span class="p">,</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">  <span class="nt">&#34;updated_at&#34;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&#34;0001-01-01T00:00:00Z&#34;</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="p">}</span>
</span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="when-to-update-templates">
	When to Update Templates
</h3>
<ul>
<li>When adding new required fields to a schema</li>
<li>When changing default values</li>
<li>When adding new optional fields that should have example values</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="what-not-to-commit">
	What NOT to Commit
</h2>
<p><strong>CRITICAL</strong>: Do not commit generated files. Only commit source schema files.</p>
<h3 id="-do-not-commit">
	❌ Do NOT Commit
</h3>
<table>
  <thead>
      <tr>
          <th>Directory/File</th>
          <th>Description</th>
      </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
      <tr>
          <td><code>models/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/&lt;package&gt;.go</code></td>
          <td>Auto-generated Go structs</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>typescript/generated/</code></td>
          <td>Generated TypeScript types and schemas</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>dist/</code></td>
          <td>Built distribution files</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>_openapi_build/</code></td>
          <td>Bundled OpenAPI specs</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>merged_openapi.yml</code></td>
          <td>Generated merged spec</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>cloud_openapi.yml</code></td>
          <td>Generated cloud spec</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>meshery_openapi.yml</code></td>
          <td>Generated meshery spec</td>
      </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="-do-commit">
	✅ DO Commit
</h3>
<table>
  <thead>
      <tr>
          <th>Directory/File</th>
          <th>Description</th>
      </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
      <tr>
          <td><code>constructs/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/api.yml</code></td>
          <td>Index file for each construct</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>constructs/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/*.yaml</code></td>
          <td>Subschema files</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>constructs/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/*.json</code></td>
          <td>Schema files in JSON format</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>constructs/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/templates/</code></td>
          <td>Template files</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>typescript/index.ts</code></td>
          <td>Manually maintained public API</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>models/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/*_helper.go</code></td>
          <td><strong>Manual</strong> Go helper files (SQL drivers, Entity interface)</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>models/&lt;version&gt;/&lt;package&gt;/helpers.go</code></td>
          <td><strong>Manual</strong> Go utility functions</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
          <td><code>models/core/datatype_*.go</code></td>
          <td><strong>Manual</strong> Core data type definitions</td>
      </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>Note</strong>: The <code>models/</code> directory contains both auto-generated files (e.g., <code>model.go</code>) and manually created helper files (e.g., <code>model_helper.go</code>). Only the auto-generated struct files should NOT be committed. Helper files that implement interfaces, SQL drivers, and utility methods ARE committed and maintained manually.</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 id="testing-your-changes">
	Testing Your Changes
</h2>
<h3 id="run-full-build">
	Run Full Build
</h3>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">make build
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">npm run build
</span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="run-go-tests">
	Run Go Tests
</h3>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">go <span class="nb">test</span> ./...
</span></span></code></pre></div><h3 id="verify-generated-code">
	Verify Generated Code
</h3>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"># Check Go code compiles</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">go build ./...
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl"><span class="c1"># Check TypeScript compiles</span>
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">npm run build
</span></span></code></pre></div><hr>
<h2 id="common-mistakes-to-avoid">
	Common Mistakes to Avoid
</h2>
<ol>
<li>❌ <strong>Committing auto-generated Go structs</strong> (<code>models/&lt;pkg&gt;/&lt;pkg&gt;.go</code>) - but DO commit helper files</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Using deprecated <code>core.json</code></strong> references instead of <code>v1alpha1/core/api.yml</code></li>
<li>❌ <strong>Adding redundant <code>x-oapi-codegen-extra-tags</code></strong> when using core schema references</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Forgetting to update template files</strong> when adding new fields</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Not testing the build</strong> after schema changes</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Placing template files outside</strong> the <code>templates/</code> subdirectory</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Using <code>.d.ts</code> extension</strong> in TypeScript import paths</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Assuming schema property names are PascalCase</strong> (check actual generated files)</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Not adding new schemas to <code>typescript/index.ts</code></strong> for public API exposure</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Forgetting <code>x-go-type</code></strong> when referencing other constructs</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Editing auto-generated <code>.go</code> files</strong> instead of creating helper files</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Forgetting <code>// This is not autogenerated.</code></strong> comment in helper files</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Missing <code>TableName()</code> method</strong> in helper files for GORM entities</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Not implementing <code>Scan()</code>/<code>Value()</code></strong> for complex types stored in SQL</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Writing manual <code>Scan()</code>/<code>Value()</code> methods</strong> when <code>x-generate-db-helpers: true</code> on the schema component would auto-generate them</li>
<li>❌ <strong>Using <code>x-generate-db-helpers</code></strong> on amorphous types (use <code>x-go-type: &quot;core.Map&quot;</code> instead)</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 id="checklist-for-schema-changes">
	Checklist for Schema Changes
</h2>
<p>Before submitting a PR, verify:</p>
<ul>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Modified only schema YAML/JSON files (not auto-generated code)</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Created/updated <code>api.yml</code> as the index file if adding new construct</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Referenced all subschemas from <code>api.yml</code></li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Used non-deprecated <code>v1alpha1/core/api.yml</code> references</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Updated corresponding template files with default values</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Removed redundant <code>x-oapi-codegen-extra-tags</code> when using core refs</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Used <code>x-generate-db-helpers: true</code> for types with fixed schemas stored as JSON blobs</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Created helper files (<code>*_helper.go</code>) only for cases not covered by auto-generation</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Added <code>// This is not autogenerated.</code> comment to helper files</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Implemented <code>TableName()</code>, <code>Scan()</code>, <code>Value()</code> as needed in helper files</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Used <code>sync.Mutex</code> for thread-safe <code>Create()</code> methods</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Added <code>x-order</code> tags for consistent field ordering</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Ran <code>make build</code> successfully</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Ran <code>go test ./...</code> successfully</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Ran <code>npm run build</code> successfully</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Updated <code>typescript/index.ts</code> if adding new public types</li>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Verified only source schema files are in the commit</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="1-mesheryctl-contributor-flow">
	1. Mesheryctl Contributor Flow
</h3>
<p>a. Add a new schema on a new command</p>
<p><strong>Example:</strong> You want to add a <code>mesheryctl model build</code> command.
<strong>Steps:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Add the new verb in <code>openapi.yaml</code> under the appropriate construct (e.g., <code>model/</code>)</li>
<li>Update <code>&lt;construct&gt;.json</code> if new properties are needed</li>
<li>Run:</li>
</ul>
<div class="highlight"><pre tabindex="0" class="chroma"><code class="language-bash" data-lang="bash"><span class="line"><span class="cl">make generate-types
</span></span><span class="line"><span class="cl">make golang-generate 
</span></span></code></pre></div><ul>
<li>Implement the CLI logic</li>
<li>Add tests (Check existing unit tests for format)</li>
</ul>
<p>b. Add an existing schema on an existing command</p>
<p><strong>Example</strong>:
